# optcompR

Unified mathematical optimization and computational modeling in R.

optcompR is a solver independent modeling layer. Variables, parameters,
constraints and objectives are written with ordinary R operators; models
are classified (LP, MILP, QP, MIQP, QCQP, MIQCQP, SOCP, CONIC, NLP,
MINLP) with recorded convexity evidence, lowered to sparse standard
forms and solved by installed backends. Results carry standardized
statuses, duals with one documented sign convention, and diagnostics
recomputed independently from the model.

``` r

library(optcompR)

m <- opt_model("max")
x <- opt_variable(m, "x", lower = 0)
y <- opt_variable(m, "y", lower = 0)
cap <- opt_constraint(m, x + y <= 4, name = "capacity")
opt_constraint(m, x <= 2)
opt_constraint(m, y <= 3)
opt_objective(m, 3 * x + 2 * y)

r <- opt_solve(m)
opt_status(r)          # "optimal"
opt_value(r, c(x, y))  # 2 2
opt_dual(r, cap)       # shadow price 2
opt_check(r)           # independent feasibility and KKT checks
```

## Features

- Vectorized expressions with sparse `Matrix` support, built in
  milliseconds for 1e5 terms.
- Parameters for reusable models, scenario sweeps and warm starts.
- Exact gradients, Jacobians and Lagrangian Hessians of every model
  function.
- External R functions with supplied, jaxR or explicitly labeled finite
  difference gradients.
- Sensitivity: duals as derivatives of the optimal value, HiGHS ranging,
  fixed relaxations of MILPs.
- Multiobjective scalarizations: weighted sums, lexicographic order and
  epsilon constraints.
- Exact feasibility and optimality certificates for LP and MILP through
  Z3 (z3r).
- Second-order, semidefinite, exponential and power cone constraints.
- Indicator constraints, SOS1 and SOS2 sets, complementarity and logical
  constraints, native in SCIP and exactly reformulated elsewhere.
- Mixed-integer nonlinear programming by NLP branch and bound.
- Robust constraints (box, budget, ellipsoid), Gaussian and scenario
  chance constraints, CVaR, sample average and distributionally robust
  expectations.
- Derivatives of optimal solutions with respect to parameters by
  implicit differentiation of the KKT conditions.
- Least squares fitting of modelcompR ODE models with exact
  sensitivities.
- Conversion to and from symcompR expressions.

## Solver support

| Backend | Package | Classes | Global for | Duals | Ranging | Warm start |
|----|----|----|----|----|----|----|
| highs | highs | LP, MILP, convex QP | all of these | LP, QP | LP | yes |
| clarabel | clarabel | LP, convex QP, SOCP, CONIC (SOC, PSD, exp, power) | all of these | yes | no | no |
| scip | scip | LP, MILP, QP, MIQP, QCQP, MIQCQP, SOCP, MISOCP | all, including nonconvex | no | no | no |
| osqp | osqp | convex QP, LP | convex problems | yes | no | no |
| nloptr | nloptr | NLP, QCQP, QP, LP (SLSQP) | convex problems | estimated | no | start point |
| ipopt | IPOPT library | NLP, QCQP, QP, LP (exact Hessians) | convex problems | yes | no | start point |
| nlpbb | nloptr | MINLP, MIQCQP, MIQP | convex relaxations | no | no | no |
| roi | ROI + plugin | plugin classes | plugin | plugin | no | no |

HiGHS is required; the others are optional. The IPOPT backend is
compiled in when `pkg-config` finds IPOPT at installation
(`brew install ipopt`, `apt install coinor-libipopt-dev`); check with
[`opt_ipopt_available()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/optcompR/reference/opt_ipopt_available.md).

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("adamrsophie/optcompR")
```

Optional integrations: `remotes::install_github("adamrsophie/z3r")`
(needs the Z3 library),
`remotes::install_github("adamrsophie/symcompR")`,
`remotes::install_github("adamrsophie/jaxR")`,
`remotes::install_github("adamrsophie/modelcompR")`.

## Documentation

Articles at <https://adamrsophie.github.io/optcompR/> cover linear,
quadratic, mixed-integer, nonlinear, conic, robust, stochastic and
multiobjective optimization, indicator and SOS constraints,
parameterized and sparse models, solver comparison, diagnostics,
infeasible models, sensitivity, derivatives of optimal solutions, exact
certificates, ODE fitting and the underlying concepts.

## License

GPL-3.

## Models and variables

- [`opt_model()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/optcompR/reference/opt_model.md)
  : Create an optimization model
- [`opt_variable()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/optcompR/reference/opt_variable.md)
  : Add decision variables to a model
- [`opt_parameter()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/optcompR/reference/opt_parameter.md)
  : Add parameters to a model
- [`opt_get()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/optcompR/reference/opt_get.md)
  : Retrieve a variable or parameter block by name
- [`opt_variables()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/optcompR/reference/opt_variables.md)
  : List the variables of a model
- [`opt_set_bounds()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/optcompR/reference/opt_set_bounds.md)
  : Change variable bounds
- [`opt_set_type()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/optcompR/reference/opt_set_type.md)
  : Change variable types
- [`opt_fix()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/optcompR/reference/opt_fix.md)
  : Fix variables to values
- [`opt_set_start()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/optcompR/reference/opt_set_start.md)
  : Set start values for variables
- [`opt_set_parameter()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/optcompR/reference/opt_set_parameter.md)
  : Change parameter values

## Diagnostics, derivatives and sensitivity

- [`opt_check()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/optcompR/reference/opt_check.md)
  : Independent feasibility and optimality diagnostics
- [`opt_gradient()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/optcompR/reference/opt_gradient.md)
  [`opt_jacobian()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/optcompR/reference/opt_gradient.md)
  [`opt_hessian()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/optcompR/reference/opt_gradient.md)
  : Exact derivatives of the objective and constraints
- [`opt_solution_jacobian()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/optcompR/reference/opt_solution_jacobian.md)
  : Derivatives of the optimal solution with respect to parameters
- [`opt_sensitivity()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/optcompR/reference/opt_sensitivity.md)
  : Linear programming sensitivity report
- [`opt_fixed_relaxation()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/optcompR/reference/opt_fixed_relaxation.md)
  : Continuous problem with integer variables fixed
- [`opt_scenarios()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/optcompR/reference/opt_scenarios.md)
  : Solve a model over parameter scenarios

## Multiobjective optimization

- [`opt_weighted()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/optcompR/reference/opt_weighted.md)
  : Weighted-sum scalarization
- [`opt_lexicographic()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/optcompR/reference/opt_lexicographic.md)
  : Lexicographic optimization
- [`opt_epsilon_constraint()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/optcompR/reference/opt_epsilon_constraint.md)
  : Epsilon-constraint method for two objectives

## Integrations

- [`opt_z3_check()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/optcompR/reference/opt_z3_check.md)
  : Exact feasibility check with Z3
- [`opt_z3_certify()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/optcompR/reference/opt_z3_certify.md)
  : Certify a MILP or LP optimum with Z3
- [`opt_from_sym()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/optcompR/reference/opt_from_sym.md)
  : Convert a symcompR expression to an optimization expression
- [`opt_to_sym()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/optcompR/reference/opt_to_sym.md)
  : Convert an optimization expression to a symcompR expression
- [`opt_ode_loss()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/optcompR/reference/opt_ode_loss.md)
  : Least squares loss of an ODE model from modelcompR
